description_json.name: Vigenere with Fixed Key KEY
description_json.idea: A polyalphabetic substitution cipher using a repeating fixed key 'KEY'. The shift value changes for each letter based on the corresponding letter of the key ('K' shifts by 10, 'E' shifts by 4, 'Y' shifts by 24). Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters are ignored by the key-pointer and left unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Convert the key 'KEY' to shift values: K=10, E=4, Y=24.
2. Maintain a key index pointer starting at 0.
3. For each character in the plaintext:
   a. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it forward by the shift value at the current key index: new_char = (char - 'A' + shift) % 26 + 'A'. Increment the key index pointer by 1 (modulo 3).
   b. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it forward by the shift value at the current key index: new_char = (char - 'a' + shift) % 26 + 'a'. Increment the key index pointer by 1 (modulo 3).
   c. If it is any other character (digit, space, punctuation), leave it unchanged. Do not increment the key index pointer.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. Convert the key 'KEY' to shift values: K=10, E=4, Y=24.
2. Maintain a key index pointer starting at 0.
3. For each character in the ciphertext:
   a. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it backward by the shift value at the current key index: new_char = (char - 'A' - shift + 26) % 26 + 'A'. Increment the key index pointer by 1 (modulo 3).
   b. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it backward by the shift value at the current key index: new_char = (char - 'a' - shift + 26) % 26 + 'a'. Increment the key index pointer by 1 (modulo 3).
   c. If it is any other character (digit, space, punctuation), leave it unchanged. Do not increment the key index pointer.

ciphers.name: qwerty

description_json.name: QWERTY monoalphabetic substitution cipher
description_json.idea: A fixed one-to-one substitution over the English alphabet. Each plaintext letter is replaced by exactly one ciphertext letter using a single bijection, and the mapping is the same for uppercase and lowercase letters. Non-letter characters are left unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Use the following bijection: plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -> ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm. Thus a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t, f->y, g->u, h->i, i->o, j->p, k->a, l->s, m->d, n->f, o->g, p->h, q->j, r->k, s->l, t->z, u->x, v->c, w->v, x->b, y->n, z->m. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Use the inverse bijection: ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm -> plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz. Thus q->a, w->b, e->c, r->d, t->e, y->f, u->g, i->h, o->i, p->j, a->k, s->l, d->m, f->n, g->o, h->p, j->q, k->r, l->s, z->t, x->u, c->v, v->w, b->x, n->y, m->z. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
